method: Compared Atlas skill descriptions for all 14 heroes named by the 2.2.23 community patch references against the reported patch changes. This is a text-level comparison, not a live-client verification.

details: Atlas snapshot describes the pre-revamp kit: Kupa revive channel, old passive/skill damage and 12-second ultimate. Patch 2.2.23 reports a revamped kit and 9-second Enraged state. Replace only after confirming full new skill values.
results.action: Create a new 2.2.23 skill snapshot; preserve old snapshot.

details: Atlas says Mystic Barrier contact damage is 220 + 65% Total Magic Power and Mystic Field damage is also 220 + 65%. Patch report says Barrier direct damage was removed and Mystic Field changed to 440-690 + 130% Total Magic Power.
results.action: Mark old values superseded for 2.2.23; record new reported values pending live-client confirmation.

details: Atlas passive still uses the old Spell Vamp/Magic Penetration conversion description. Patch report adds immediate 10% Spell Vamp or 10% Magic Penetration on switching balance.
Atlas Chaos Assault text has 2.5% target-HP extra damage; patch report changes extra percentage damage from 2.5%-5% to 3.5%-5%.
Atlas Chaos ultimate text is 250-450 + 100% Total Magic Power; patch report gives 150-300 + 135% Total Magic Power.
results.action: Split passive, Chaos Skill 2 and Chaos Ultimate into separate patch-scoped parameters.

details: Atlas contains a skill snapshot, but the patch references reviewed here only summarize a buff outside Ultimate and reduced Ultimate availability; exact values were not captured in the available structured excerpt.
results.action: Do not edit numbers yet; obtain detailed patch text or live-client test.

details: Patch references identify a nerf, but the exact skill-level numerical deltas were not available in the structured excerpt used for this comparison.
Passive extra Physical Damage in Atlas: (3 + 2% Extra Physical Attack + 0.2 × Hero Level)% in the claw-strike text; patch report gives (2 + 0.5% Extra Physical Attack + 0.2 × Hero Level)% Max HP.
Atlas Feral Swipe still says 50% slow on hero hit; patch report says that slow was removed and moved to Skill 2.
Atlas Feral Swipe damage bonus is 70%; patch report changes it to 55%.
Atlas Claw Strike is 120 + 80% Extra Physical Attack; patch report changes it to 60-240 + 40% Extra Physical Attack.
results.action: Create a new patch snapshot; preserve the old Masha values.

details: Atlas Flash Combo still reports Pulverize 280 + 120% Total Physical Attack and spin damage 80 + 45% Total Physical Attack. Patch report gives Pulverize 400-800 + 60% Total Physical Attack and Spin 95-235 + 25% Total Physical Attack.
results.action: Split Pulverize and Spin into level-indexed parameters for patch 2.2.23.

details: Patch report says Basic Attack splash damage changed to Magic Damage. Atlas passive text already describes Uranus Basic Attack damage as Magic Damage, but does not isolate the splash component; this is not enough to confirm the affected component is correctly represented.

details: Patch report changes Muddles damage transfer and Attack Effect Inheritance from 52% fixed to 50%-60%. Atlas skill description does not expose these ratios as structured parameters.
